commands: uv run harness perception audit --run runs/bnd-perception-corpus-02 --envelope analysis/perception-audit/envelope.json --output analysis/perception-audit/records/bnd-perception-corpus-02/report.json

decision_rules.multiplicity: per-stratum floors are all-must-pass; no pooling rescue (BND-7)
decision_rules.stopping_rule: 16 randomized sessions per interface per candidate (BND-9); no threshold relaxed after results (BND-10)

disposition: short_composition candidate expert_t1_l2 is not perception-eligible on the frozen envelope (BND-7); role open pending a new candidate round (BND-10)

primary.aggregation: proportion per interface with exact interval; selection by BND-10 rule on pooled rate
per stratum lower bound vs frozen floor

secondary.aggregation: paired equivalence interval within frozen margins (BND-8)

exclusions.deviation_policy: any behaviour-affecting change after registration is a documented deviation record and a new campaign version id; confirmatory data never revises the registered protocol
infrastructure: session launcher failure before first agent turn
provider outage recorded by the controller
exclusions.rerun_policy: a permitted rerun receives a new randomized id; the original row is retained with its exclusion reason and never replaced in place
treatment_integrity: pre-registered treatment-integrity invalidation only; reported, never replaced (BND-9)
any oracle-derived signal on a policy path (BND-2)

hypotheses.statement: At least one candidate per role is perception-eligible, expert-parity-passing, and lands in the 0.20-0.80 intent-to-treat pilot band on both interfaces (BND-7..9).

integrity_checks.owner_role: perception auditor (audit ran; candidate not eligible under BND-7)
parity harness (blocked: no monolithic control surface exists yet, MON-1 baseline is empty)

seed_commitment.rule: 32 distinct integers in [1000,9999) drawn once from the OS CSPRNG, retained only under ~/aisle-private/freeze/bnd-task-band-calibration-v1/, disjoint by value from every committed dev/pilot seed list; revealed after the campaign closes

superseded: bnd-task-band-calibration-v1 (registered before the perception auditor existed)
